description: Angular component for configuring value chart card widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and preview functionality.

classes.name: ValueChartCardWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for widget settings configuration, extending WidgetSettingsComponent.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on showValue toggle.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string of the value based on current widget configuration.
